newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan dissolves Sindh province parliament.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan dissolves Sindh province parliament.

text.p: The Governor of Pakistan's southern province of Sindh, Kamal Azfar, dissolved the provincial parliament on Thursday and sacked the provincial government, his spokesman said.
He said Azfar named Mumtaz Bhutto, an estranged uncle of ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto as the troubled province's caretaker chief minister.
"The assembly has been dissolved and the new chief minister would be sworn (in) this evening," the spokesman said in Karachi, the provincial capital.

The caretaker chief minister will replace Abdullah Shah of Benazir Bhutto's Pakistan People's Party (PPP), whose dismissal comes two days after his leader was sacked by President Farooq Leghari on disputed charges of corruption and misrule.
Mumtaz, an opposition deputy in the dissolved assembly, is the first cousin of Benazir's father, executed former prime minister Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto.
